title: C++ Core Guidelines
author: Bjarne Stroustrup, Herb Sutter
description: The authoritative, continuously updated set of guidelines for writing modern C++ well — resource and memory safety, RAII, interfaces, classes, templates, concurrency, error handling, and performance — each rule with rationale and examples. Maintained by the Standard C++ Foundation.
